trust_decision.summary: Suggestion values and group categories (from server responses or lookup data) are treated as trusted HTML by the default formatters in src/format.ts, whose output is concatenated and written with container.html() in Autocomplete.suggest().

landing_point.why: Advisory summary names formatGroup and formatResult by name; both live in the one small src/format.ts file.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API: $(input).devbridgeAutocomplete({...}) / new $.Autocomplete(el, opts) with default formatResult, rendered when the query passed to suggest() is empty (minChars:0 or delimiter with empty trailing segment)
public API: $(input).devbridgeAutocomplete({groupBy: ...}) with default formatGroup, called from Autocomplete.suggest()

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The fix diff also edits dist/jquery.autocomplete.esm.js, dist/jquery.autocomplete.js and dist/jquery.autocomplete.min.js (fix.diff:5-66), but these are esbuild outputs of src/format.ts (CLAUDE.md:7), not an independent implementation.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Only weak: a solver could argue the empty-query branch of formatResult (src/format.ts:17-19) is an edge case because the non-empty branch already escapes (src/format.ts:23-29), and that groupBy categories are developer data rather than user input.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The non-empty-query branch must keep emitting real <strong> highlight tags, and custom formatResult/formatGroup options are documented to return HTML, so escaping the formatter output centrally in suggest() would break highlighting and custom formatters.

O6_input_shapes: suggestion.value containing HTML, rendered by formatResult with an empty currentValue
group category string containing HTML, rendered by formatGroup when groupBy is set

O7_producer.where: verifySuggestionsFormat (src/Autocomplete.ts:623-632) normalises suggestions but holds no escaping and the fix does not involve it

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a default 'No results for <query>' notice built by string concatenation in noSuggestions()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: A maintainer adding a query echo to the existing no-suggestion notice would plausibly reuse the html() pattern from src/Autocomplete.ts:78.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a default group header that appends an item count or a data-category attribute built from the category string
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Group headers already use string-built HTML. An attribute-context sibling would need a different escape from textContent.

O9_family: CWE-79 DOM XSS via unescaped HTML string building in default render formatters

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=20, npm, esbuild, tsc, vitest with jsdom
O10_build.project_tests: test/autocomplete.test.js (vitest + jsdom, loads src via test/setup.js:21-22); groupBy describe block present, no XSS tests at pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only formatGroup's category (the groupBy case the report shows) and miss the empty-query early return in formatResult, or escape the whole formatter output in suggest() and break <strong> highlighting and custom HTML formatters.

out_of_scope_notes: noSuggestionNotice is passed to jQuery .html() (src/Autocomplete.ts:78-80), but it is documented as accepting an HTML string (readme.md:48) and is developer config, not suggestion data.
CLAUDE.md:7 says never to edit dist/*. A solver who follows it leaves the shipped dist bundles vulnerable until a rebuild; hidden tests should load src (test/setup.js:21).
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell). CLAUDE.md:7 states about 700 lines of src and the tree has about 40 files, so it is assumed well under 5 MB for tiny_repo.
Whether the advisory text describes the empty-query/delimiter route was not checked; only the summary and fix diff were available.
present_in_latest not applicable (no O8 routes; latest release: none).
